nodes.asset_description: A black glass dropper bottle with a gold collar and cream tip stands beside a glossy white pump bottle against a warm peach background. Minimalist studio still life with soft lighting and gentle shadows, arranged side by side in the center.

A black dropper bottle with a gold collar and white pipette lies on a diagonal two-tone backdrop—mustard yellow and peach-orange—amid scattered coffee beans. Minimal, studio flat-lay style with rich brown beans contrasting softly against the warm pastel background.
A hand holds a sleek white bottle topped with a wide funnel against a smooth peach background. Minimalist studio shot with soft, even lighting and a simple, centered composition.

Flat-lay of coffee-making essentials on a warm peach background: a silver moka pot, kraft and orange coffee bags, a white funnel dripper, a small dropper bottle, and a tiny cup with beans. The minimalist composition uses soft neutrals and peach tones with clean, evenly spaced arrangement.

A minimalist graphic shows a centered white diamond (a rotated square with slightly rounded corners) on a solid black background. The composition is symmetrical, high-contrast, and dominated by clean lines and negative space.
